Container.Name: Freeman Notes
Container.Overview: Freeman Notes is a self-hosted, offline-first notes app inspired by Google Keep — but with real workspaces, collections, rich-text editing, image uploads with OCR search, document attachments, real-time collaboration via Yjs, workspace invites, and a note app that stays useful when the network disappears. Requires an external PostgreSQL instance (bring your own or use a separate Unraid PostgreSQL container).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port that maps to the FreemanNotes web server. Change the left-hand value if 27015 is already in use on your server.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Persistent storage for user-uploaded images and document attachments. Map this to a path on your Unraid array or cache drive.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Example: postgresql://freemannotes:yourpassword@192.168.1.100:5432/freemannotes?schema=public — Point this at your existing PostgreSQL container or server. A separate postgres:16 Unraid container works great.

Config.Name: AUTH_JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Long random secret used to sign session tokens. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep this private and consistent — changing it will log everyone out.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Public base URL of your FreemanNotes instance. Examples: http://192.168.1.100:27015 or https://notes.yourdomain.com. Required for invite emails and secure cookie settings.

Config.Name: AUTH_ALLOW_REGISTER
Config.Description: Allow new users to register accounts. Set to false to lock down registration after initial setup.

Config.Name: AUTH_SESSION_DAYS
Config.Description: How many days a login session stays valid before requiring re-authentication.

Config.Name: AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true when serving FreemanNotes over HTTPS. Causes session cookies to be sent only over secure connections. Leave blank for plain HTTP.

Config.Name: PGTIMEZONE
Config.Description: IANA timezone name used when displaying timestamps from PostgreSQL. Storage remains UTC. Example: America/New_York. Leave blank to use UTC.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Redis connection string. Recommended for push notification bell badge reliability — ensures the in-app bell updates immediately when a reminder fires. Required for multi-instance/load-balanced deployments (workspace pub/sub). Example: redis://192.168.1.100:6379. Leave blank to run without Redis.

Config.Name: SMTP_HOST
Config.Description: Hostname of your SMTP server for sending workspace invitation emails. Leave blank to disable email sending.

Config.Name: SMTP_PORT
Config.Description: SMTP server port. Common values: 587 (STARTTLS), 465 (SSL), 25 (plain).

Config.Name: SMTP_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true to use SSL/TLS from the start of the connection (port 465). Leave false for STARTTLS (port 587).

Config.Name: SMTP_USER
Config.Description: SMTP authentication username.

Config.Name: SMTP_PASS
Config.Description: SMTP authentication password.

Config.Name: SMTP_FROM
Config.Description: The From address shown on outgoing invite and reminder emails. Example: Freeman Notes <no-reply@yourdomain.com>

Config.Name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
Config.Description: VAPID public key for Web Push notifications (Web and Android PWA). Generate a key pair with: npx web-push generate-vapid-keys. Leave blank to disable Web Push.

Config.Name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
Config.Description: VAPID private key for Web Push notifications. Keep this secret. Must be the matching pair for VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.

Config.Name: VAPID_SUBJECT
Config.Description: VAPID subject — a mailto: or https: URI that identifies the push sender. Example: mailto:admin@yourdomain.com. Required when VAPID keys are set.

Config.Name: FCM_PROJECT_ID
Config.Description: Firebase project ID for iOS push notifications via FCM. Found in Firebase Console → Project Settings → General. Leave blank to disable FCM.

Config.Name: FCM_CLIENT_EMAIL
Config.Description: Firebase service-account client email. Download the service-account JSON from Firebase Console → Project Settings → Service Accounts → Generate new private key.

Config.Name: FCM_PRIVATE_KEY
Config.Description: Firebase service-account RSA private key (the full PEM string including BEGIN/END markers). Paste the private_key field value from your Firebase service-account JSON.

Config.Name: WEB_NOTIFICATION_MODE
Config.Description: External reminder/test notification mode for desktop and non-Android browsers. auto = prefer push and fall back to email when SMTP is configured, push = push only, email = email only, off = disable external delivery.

Config.Name: ANDROID_NOTIFICATION_MODE
Config.Description: External reminder/test notification mode for Android browsers and installed PWAs. Accepts auto, push, email, or off.

Config.Name: IOS_NOTIFICATION_MODE
Config.Description: External reminder/test notification mode for iOS. Accepts auto, push, email, or off. iOS push requires the FCM settings below.

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Node.js environment. Leave as production.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal port the Node.js server listens on inside the container. Change only if you have a conflict; also update the WebUI Port mapping above to match.

Config.Name: HOST
Config.Description: Interface the server binds to inside the container. Leave as 0.0.0.0.

Config.Name: DB_SCHEMA_SYNC
Config.Description: Controls database migration behavior at startup. deploy = apply committed migrations (recommended). push = prisma db push (development only). none = skip automatic sync.

Config.Name: AUTH_BCRYPT_ROUNDS
Config.Description: bcrypt cost factor for password hashing. Higher = more secure but slower login. 12 is a good production default.

Config.Name: AUTH_COOKIE_NAME
Config.Description: Name of the session cookie. Change only if running multiple instances on the same domain.

Config.Name: UPLOAD_DIR
Config.Description: Path inside the container where uploaded files are stored. Should match the container-side target of the Uploads volume mapping above.

Config.Name: OCR_DISABLED
Config.Description: Set to 1 to disable OCR processing entirely. Useful on low-memory servers. Image and document text will not be indexed for search.

Config.Name: OCR_LOG_OUTPUT
Config.Description: Set to 1 to stream OCR child-process output and progress into the container logs.

Config.Name: OCR_PYTHON_BIN
Config.Description: Python executable used by the bundled OCR worker. Override only if you mount a custom OCR runtime into the container.

Config.Name: PADDLE_HOME
Config.Description: Writable cache directory for PaddleOCR model downloads inside the container.

Config.Name: PADDLE_PDX_MODEL_SOURCE
Config.Description: Model download source used by PaddleOCR. Leave as BOS unless you have a custom mirror requirement.

Config.Name: TRASH_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
Config.Description: How often (in milliseconds) the server scans for trashed notes past their auto-delete threshold. Default is 3600000 (1 hour).

Config.Name: WORKSPACE_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
Config.Description: How often (in milliseconds) the server scans soft-deleted workspaces that are eligible for permanent deletion. Default is 3600000 (1 hour).

Config.Name: WORKSPACE_CLEANUP_GRACE_MS
Config.Description: Grace period (in milliseconds) before a soft-deleted workspace is permanently removed. Default is 86400000 (24 hours).

Config.Name: YPERSISTENCE
Config.Description: Optional path inside the container for LevelDB-backed Yjs document persistence. Example: /data/yjs. Leave blank to keep Yjs state in memory and PostgreSQL only.

Config.Name: DEBUG_LOGGING
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable structured server-side debug logging for beta diagnostics. Leave disabled during normal operation.

Config.Name: DB_BASELINE_ON_NON_EMPTY
Config.Description: Set to true for a single startup if a prior failed install already created FreemanNotes tables and prisma migrate deploy now exits with P3005. Revert to blank after the first successful start.
